summary: The producer of the vehicle class buoyancy element list at class+52Ch is 0082D040, reached from the ship class model-binding virtual 0082FE30 at slot 8 (vtable+20h) of the ship vtables. It samples the model's "deckline" and "bottomline" polylines at Hull.Segments evenly spaced stations over Length and pushes two 24h-byte records per station (one at +Width/2, one at -Width/2) into the vector whose object base is class+528h. No displacement scan of 52Ch could find it: the only writer is std::vector::push_back at 0082C960 whose this is the vector, not the class.

question_answers.producer: 0082D040 (body 0082D040-0082D6FD), called once at 0082FEE3 from 0082FE30 (body 0082FE30-00831801), the class descriptor's model-binding virtual at vtable slot 8. The append is 0082C960, std::vector<Element,24h>::push_back, called with ECX = descriptor+528h at 0082D658 and 0082D67C.
question_answers.value_source: Two named polylines in the ship's model, not a Lua key table and not a fixed pattern from Length/Width/Height alone. 00718000 resolves the node named "deckline" (literal 00D09A0C) at 0082FEBA and "bottomline" (00D09A00) at 0082FECA out of the model at descriptor+50h; each record's +44h is a std::vector<Vec3> of points. Length (descriptor+A0h), Width (+A4h), Mass (+B0h), Hull.WaterLineRatio (+71Ch) and Hull.Segments (+720h) supply the station spacing, lateral offset and normalisation.
question_answers.record_roles: +00h buoyancy coefficient = Mass*10*0.5/draught/Hull.Segments; +04h waterline = lerp(deck, bottom, ratio); +08h deck line sample; +0Ch bottom line (keel) sample; +10h deck - bottom; +14h waterline - bottom, the draught; +18h..+20h position = (+/-Width/2, deck sample, station z).
question_answers.deruyter: VehicleClass[20] DeRuyter 1935: Length 171, Width 16, Mass 7688, Hull.Segments 5, Hull.WaterLineRatio 0.55, Mesh models/ships/us/Deruyter.mmod. The model's deckline has four points and its bottomline six; both decoded and tabulated in the doc. The ten resulting elements sit at z = -85.5, -42.75, 0, 42.75, 85.5 with x = +/-8.0, and sum(coefficient * draught) = 76880 = 10 * Mass.

host_steps.contract: read: 00718000 body 00718000-007180D5, void* __thiscall(model, const std::string* name, int kind). Walks the model record vector at model+68h..+6Ch, compares each record's std::string name at record+0Ch with 004B3FC0 requiring an exact length match and record+24h == kind, returns the LAST match or null. The points are the std::vector<Vec3> at record+44h.
